# Fixture attribution

Four of the `.pen` files here are unmodified copies of files saved by Pencil and published in
public repositories under the MIT license. They are used only to test that desigma can open
real files. The other two (`components-and-themes.pen`, `shapes.pen`) were written for desigma's
tests from the format documentation and are covered by desigma's own license.
